title: P800,000 worth of cigarettes found inside rescue vehicle in Iligan

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A vehicle reportedly being used for barangay rescue operations was found transporting around P800,000 worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes when police intercepted it at a checkpoint along Macapagal Highway in Barangay Suarez here on Thursday afternoon, October 29. Police said personnel of the Iligan City Mobile Force Company (ICMFC), led by Lt. Abdullah P. Sumayan, flagged down the white Hyundai H-100 at around 4:55 p.m. at the Suarez checkpoint after noticing that it had no front license plate. The officers became suspicious when the occupants were hesitant to disclose what the vehicle was carrying, prompting them to inspect […]...
